mathematics.assertion_tested: Evaluate the frozen full-Fock graph walk against its charged common frontend, independently reoptimized D/phase/bunching/inclusion controls and strong feasible searches; report every DEV candidate and all negative outcomes.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: float64 weighted integer adjacency; complex128 passive matrices; native Clifford2017/exqalibur arithmetic; integer occupations/costs; finite Monte Carlo.
mathematics.conventions: K distinct single-photon inputs in K+1 modes, ideal eta=1, all full-Fock occupations stars/bars-decoded; gain=max(0,Cfront-Csample); no CF filter or optimum masks.
inputs: Four fixed DEV cases: weighted ER p=.35 and RR degree4 on16/20vertices, graph seeds4501601,4501602,4502001,4502002; weights1..9 from fixed helper SHA-derived seeds.
Six theta settings in spec; each model12 training draws/setting/graph and2x64 fresh selected DEV draws/graph; independent model selection frozen before fresh draws.
Four common uniform anchors plus exactlyK^2 scored gap hops per graph, fully credited; optical source remains original chosen anchor/order.
6 reoptimized models and8 fixed classical controls, each200 new scores/graph; held-out outcomes absent.
non_claims: No positive advantage, statistical significance, global novelty or independent replication certified by a DEV pilot.
No held-out outcomes, exact optimum, optimal-state masks, QPU call, hardware feasibility or manuscript revision.
Classical graph/ordering discoveries and all scored candidates receive credit; physical attempts, scores, source photons and simulation time remain separate.
No loss resilience inferred from eta=1; all-K survival cost must be charged in a later physical model.
No full-Fock state-space enumeration; exact labeled/Fock decoder covariance is distinct from fresh-order robustness.

randomness.generator: PCG64 and independently seeded Perceval/exqalibur; SHA256 seed_for(P45B,case,stage,model,index), first4bytes little-endian; exact namespaces and graph seeds frozen in script/spec.
